These include omitting role fields during tool calls, using non-standard parameter values for reasoning efforts, and failing to support specific tool choice configurations. title: 三年了，AI为何还没有抢走程序员饭碗？
content: Despite significant productivity gains, software developer employment has remained stable, contradicting predictions of mass displacement. This occurs because AI lowers development costs, stimulating new demand and enabling more product iterations rather than reducing headcount. Furthermore, labor market data indicates that entry-level roles are declining as AI automates routine tasks, thereby increasing the relative value of experienced programmers. Thus, AI primarily shifts the workforce toward senior roles by expanding the scope of viable software projects.

title: AI 开始「互发微信」了，谁来管管它们？
content: WeChat is testing an AI agent system where agents interact directly, eliminating human intermediation. This exemplifies the emerging Agent-to-Agent (A2A) trend, supported by new protocols like Google’s A2A, which structure machine communication. While A2A improves efficiency for routine tasks, it risks accelerating misinformation through recursive error propagation and enables novel advertising attacks. Addressing these challenges requires robust security standards, identity verification, and governance frameworks to ensure trust and accountability in autonomous agent interactions.
